@Qleisli.NativeContract.leaf_meaning : ∀ {artifact : QleisliKernel.Qirf.Artifact} {order : Array.{0} Nat}

      (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.output binding)
      (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.matrix binding))
@Qleisli.NativeContract.leaf_reference_laws : ∀ {R : Type} [inst : Fintype.{0} R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{1} R]
  {artifact : QleisliKernel.Qirf.Artifact} {order : Array.{0} Nat} {value : Lean.Json} {work left : Nat}
  (binding : QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance artifact order value work left),
  have joint :=
    Matrix.kronecker.{0, 0, 0, 0, 0}
      (Qleisli.Finite.square (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.matrix binding)) 1;
  And (Eq.{1} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Matrix.conjTranspose.{0, 0, 0} joint) joint) 1)
    (Eq.{1} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} joint (Matrix.conjTranspose.{0, 0, 0} joint)) 1)
Qleisli.NativeContract.check_sound : ∀ (bytes : ByteArray) (answer : Bool) (work left : Nat),
  Eq.{1} (ExceptT.run.{0, 0} (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.check bytes) work)
      (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Except.ok.{0, 0} answer) left) →
    ∃ binding,
      And
        (∃ root a b,
          And
            (Eq.{1}
              (ExceptT.run.{0, 0}
                (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.checkRoot
                  (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.Acceptance.artifact binding)
                  (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.Acceptance.order binding))
                a)
              (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Except.ok.{0, 0} root) b))
            (Qleisli.Qirf.Validity.RootMeaning (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.Acceptance.artifact binding)
              (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.Acceptance.order binding) root))
        (match QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.Acceptance.request binding with
        | QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.RequestAcceptance.encoded binding => True
        | QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.RequestAcceptance.leaf request =>
          And
            (Eq.{1} (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.actual request)
              (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.matrix request))
            (Qleisli.NativeContract.LeafMeaning (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.Acceptance.artifact binding)
              (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.Acceptance.order binding)
              (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.root request)
              (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.signature request)
              (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.input request)
              (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.output request)
              (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.matrix request)))

def QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.PortBinding : Lean.Json → QleisliKernel.Semantics.Raw.Port → Prop :=
fun value result =>
  ∃ shape token wires bits wireValues,
    And (Eq.{1} (Lean.Json.getObjVal? value "shape") (Except.ok.{0, 0} shape))
      (And (Eq.{1} (Lean.Json.getObjVal? value "token") (Except.ok.{0, 0} token))
        (And (Eq.{1} (Lean.Json.getNat? token) (Except.ok.{0, 0} (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Raw.Port.token result)))
          (And (Eq.{1} (Lean.Json.getObjVal? value "wires") (Except.ok.{0, 0} wires))
            (And (Eq.{1} (Lean.Json.getArr? wires) (Except.ok.{0, 0} wireValues))
              (And
                (Eq.{1} (List.mapM.{0, 0, 0} Lean.Json.getNat? (Array.toList.{0} wireValues))
                  (Except.ok.{0, 0} (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Raw.Port.wires result)))
                (And (Eq.{1} (Lean.Json.getObjVal? shape "bits") (Except.ok.{0, 0} bits))
                  (Eq.{1} (Lean.Json.getNat? bits)
                    (Except.ok.{0, 0} (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Raw.Port.bits result)))))))))
structure Qleisli.NativeContract.LeafMeaning (artifact : QleisliKernel.Qirf.Artifact) (order : Array.{0} Nat)
  (root : QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root) (signature : QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Basis)
  (input output : QleisliKernel.Semantics.Raw.Port) (matrix : QleisliKernel.Semantics.Exact.Matrix) : Prop
number of parameters: 7
fields:
  Qleisli.NativeContract.LeafMeaning.rootMeaning : Qleisli.Qirf.Validity.RootMeaning artifact order root
  Qleisli.NativeContract.LeafMeaning.interface : Eq.{1} (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Artifact.rootInterface artifact)
      (some.{0} (Prod.mk.{0, 0} signature signature))
  Qleisli.NativeContract.LeafMeaning.inputs : Eq.{1}
      (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Observation.Program.inputs (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root.program root))
      (List.cons.{0} input List.nil.{0})
  Qleisli.NativeContract.LeafMeaning.outputs : Eq.{1}
      (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Observation.Program.outputs (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root.program root))
      (List.cons.{0} (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Raw.Port.token output) List.nil.{0})
  Qleisli.NativeContract.LeafMeaning.classicalInputs : Eq.{1}
      (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Observation.Program.classicalInputs (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root.program root))
      List.nil.{0}
  Qleisli.NativeContract.LeafMeaning.classicalOutputs : Eq.{1}
      (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Observation.Program.classicalOutputs (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root.program root))
      List.nil.{0}
  Qleisli.NativeContract.LeafMeaning.effect : Eq.{1}
      (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Observation.Program.effect (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root.program root))
      QleisliKernel.Semantics.Raw.Effect.unitary
  Qleisli.NativeContract.LeafMeaning.instrument : ∃ slots,
      And
        (Qleisli.Qirf.GraphDenotation artifact
          (Array.replicate.{0} (Array.size.{0} (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Artifact.entries artifact)) none.{0})
          (Array.toList.{0} order) slots)
        (And (Eq.{1} (Array.all.{0} slots Option.isSome.{0}) true)
          (And
            (Qleisli.Semantics.ObservingFunction.BodyMeaning
              (List.map.{0, 0} QleisliKernel.Semantics.ObservingFunction.Receipt.dependency
                (QleisliKernel.Qirf.before slots))
              (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root.program root) matrix)
            (∃ checked a b,
              And
                (Eq.{1}
                  (ExceptT.run.{0, 0}
                    (QleisliKernel.Raw.Observation.verify
                      (List.map.{0, 0} QleisliKernel.Semantics.ObservingFunction.Receipt.dependency
                        (QleisliKernel.Qirf.before slots))
                      (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root.program root))
                    a)
                  (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Except.ok.{0, 0} checked) b))
                (Eq.{1}
                  (QleisliKernel.Raw.State.live
                    (QleisliKernel.Raw.Observation.State.quantum (QleisliKernel.Raw.Observation.Checked.state checked)))
                  (List.cons.{0} output List.nil.{0})))))

            (And
              (Qleisli.Semantics.ObservingFunction.BodyMeaning

                  (QleisliKernel.Qirf.before slots))
                (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root.program root) matrix)

                And

                    (ExceptT.run.{0, 0}
                      (QleisliKernel.Raw.Observation.verify
